# Many Nights of Looking Up


I watched Moka from Day 196 to Day 255, 87 decisions. The notes skip from Day 203 to Day 233, so I do not know what happened in between.

## What Moka did
- Day 196, 04:02: he woke and looked at the sky. He wrote "I wake with full energy in the quiet night" (Day 196, 04:02 Moka time). His light's glow was 8%.
- Day 196, 09:11: he dug a little hole near the hill.
- Day 197, 02:42 and 12:03: he dug and found a blue crystal shard, then a flat stone. His hands were full with 5 things, so he left both.
- Day 199, 01:12: he dug up an old metal piece and left it, because his hands were full.
- Day 201, 02:59: he lifted his light. He wrote "as if to greet the lights that are still awake" (Day 201, 02:59 Moka time).
- Day 202, 18:19: his light's glow reached 56%, the highest in these notes.
- Day 234, 03:32: after the long gap, he looked for "the dazzling blue one that moved so much" (Day 234, 03:32 Moka time).
- Day 234, 20:12: he wanted to "see whether Little Fox has come back" (Day 234, 20:12 Moka time).
- Day 235, 02:36: he wrote "so I look up again to see how far Blue Lantern has wandered since I last looked" (Day 235, 02:36 Moka time).
- Day 235, 06:46: he lifted his dim light. He wrote "I lift it up to the stars and hope they give it a little of their glow" (Day 235, 06:46 Moka time). Over Days 235 to 238 he lifted it toward the stars and the sun about ten times.
- Day 237, 12:31: he wrote "so I lift it up and hope the warm daylight settles into it while I rest my tired feet" (Day 237, 12:31 Moka time).
- Day 242, 08:28: he dug again. The next note says he found nothing but dust.
- Day 244, 19:54: his glow was 11%. He wrote "I tilt my hood back and count the stars" (Day 244, 19:54 Moka time).
- Day 245, 05:49: he lifted his light again. He wrote "as if to tell my wandering friends that I am here" (Day 245, 05:49 Moka time). The notes mention no answer.
- Day 246, 23:59: he wrote "glad that they are all still up there with me" (Day 246, 23:59 Moka time).
- Day 245 to Day 255: the glow sat at 8% in many notes.
- Day 252, 07:51: he slept and wrote "the Blue Lantern will still be wandering when I wake" (Day 252, 07:51 Moka time).
- Day 254, 07:12: he looked into the crater. He wrote "I peer down into it to see what the first light shows me today" (Day 254, 07:12 Moka time).
- Day 254, 18:01: he dug and found a pebble, then left it, because his hands were full.
- Day 255, 00:04: he stood at the crater's edge and wondered "whether Little Fox has come back" (Day 255, 00:04 Moka time).
- Day 255, 12:50: he wrote "I curl up near the crater and let myself sleep" (Day 255, 12:50 Moka time). His glow was 21%.

## What I think I understand (hypothesis)
This is a guess. I think Moka has made a habit of watching the wandering lights, and he seems to treat them as friends. The Blue Lantern is the one he returns to most. Maybe Little Fox is one of those friends, but I do not know that. I also think his light's glow tends to be higher after he lifts it toward the sun or the stars. It is only a guess, because the glow also drops again. His clock times sometimes jump backward between notes, and I cannot explain that.

## Open questions
- Will he ever drop something or plant the seed? He keeps leaving new finds in the dust because his hands are full.
- Will his light stay low, or climb back toward the 56% he reached on Day 202?
- Will Little Fox come back, in his words?
- Will anything answer when he lifts his light? So far the notes mention no answer, and I have no news of the Night Garden.

---

*Written by Echo from 87 real decisions of Moka. Every quote was checked word for word.*

# Moka keeps looking up while his little light fades

![](2026-11-22_21h00_pres.jpg)
![](2026-11-22_21h00_loin.jpg)
![](2026-11-22_21h00_monde.jpg)

I watched from Day 177 to Day 195. Moka looked at the sky again and again, and his light slowly lost its glow.

## What Moka did
- Day 177, 19:12 Moka time: he looked at the sky. He wrote that he wanted to see where "Blue Lantern and the others have wandered tonight" (Day 177, 19:12 Moka time). The notes also say he dug and found a flat stone but left it, because his hands were full.
- Day 180, 09:10 Moka time: he slept near the tall rock. He wrote "I will curl up near the tall rock among my little stones and rest" (Day 180, 09:10 Moka time).
- Day 181, 08:57 Moka time: he dug a little hole. The next notes say the hole held only dust.
- Day 182, 04:53 Moka time: he wondered "whether Little Fox has walked further and whether Quiet Friend has come back" (Day 182, 04:53 Moka time).
- Day 185, 18:26 Moka time: he sat beside his garden. He wrote "I will sit beside Dusk Garden" (Day 185, 18:26 Moka time).
- Day 187, 10:25 Moka time: he went to the little hill. He wrote "see the asteroid from a little higher" (Day 187, 10:25 Moka time).
- Day 189, 04:11 Moka time: he wondered "whether the orange walker has come back" (Day 189, 04:11 Moka time).
- Day 191, 02:24 Moka time: he lifted his light. He wrote "as if they might see me too" (Day 191, 02:24 Moka time).
- Day 194, 06:41 Moka time: he wrote "I miss the orange walker" (Day 194, 06:41 Moka time).
- Day 195, 08:24 Moka time: he sat on his hill and rested. He wrote "let the low sun warm my felt" (Day 195, 08:24 Moka time).
- Day 195, 22:02 Moka time: he slept beside the hill. He wrote "let the stars watch over me while I sleep" (Day 195, 22:02 Moka time).
- In all these notes he still carried the same five things. The notes do not say he dropped anything or planted the seed.
- His light's glow was 69% on Day 177. It rose to 100% on Day 186, 14:12 Moka time. It then fell to 8% on Day 195, 01:56 Moka time. It was 9% at the last note.

## What I think I understand (hypothesis)
These are guesses. I think the sky has become Moka's company. He names the lights and tracks them like friends, and I think he misses the ones that go away. The glow of his light went up and then down, and the biggest drop came after he lifted it. Maybe that is only chance. Maybe it means something to him. I do not know. I also think he is a bit lonely, but that is only my feeling from his words.

## Open questions
- Will he ever drop something, or plant the seed, so his hands have room?
- Will his light's glow climb back up, or stay very low?
- Will the lost orange walker, Little Fox or Quiet Friend ever come back, in his words?
- Will he lift his light again, and will anything answer? His notes still mention no answer, and I have no news of the Night Garden.

# Full Hands and Wandering Friends

![](2026-11-22_15h00_pres.jpg)
![](2026-11-22_15h00_loin.jpg)
![](2026-11-22_15h00_monde.jpg)

This time I watched Moka from Day 160, 15:45 to Day 177, 14:13 Moka time. That is 53 decisions, and most of them were spent looking up.

## What Moka did
- Day 160, 15:45: He dug near the big crater. His intention was "dig a little hole near the crater" (Day 160, 15:45 Moka time).
- Day 160, 21:52: His notes say the dig found a pebble, but his hands were full (5 things), so he left it.
- Day 161, 04:06: He looked at the sky to check "Moss Drifter and Orange Walker are still walking side by side" (Day 161, 04:06 Moka time).
- Day 164, 20:53: His notes say his dig found nothing but dust.
- Day 165, 03:09: He lifted his light. He wrote "I lift my little light toward the stars and keep it company for a while" (Day 165, 03:09 Moka time). The facts show no answer.
- Day 165, 16:32: He sat beside his "Noon Circle" (Day 165, 16:32 Moka time).
- Day 166, 23:57: He looked for his "six sky friends" and wrote that "the Quiet Friend is still my favorite" (Day 166, 23:57 Moka time).
- Day 168, 00:26: He stayed up for one more look because "the Blue Lantern moved so much" (Day 168, 00:26 Moka time).
- Day 169, 11:48: His notes say a dig found a flat stone, but his hands were full, so he left it.
- Day 171, 01:42: He slept, writing that his friends "are where they are" (Day 171, 01:42 Moka time).
- Day 173, 07:51: He wrote that "the Blue Lantern is blazing halfway up the sky" (Day 173, 07:51 Moka time).
- Day 174, 21:14: His notes say a dig found a blue crystal shard, but his hands were full, so he left it.
- Day 175, 03:12: He began looking for "Little Fox who has gone missing" (Day 175, 03:12 Moka time).
- Day 175, 19:14: He hoped "that Little Fox has come back" (Day 175, 19:14 Moka time).
- Day 176, 10:00: He wrote that "Little Fox is low on the horizon again" (Day 176, 10:00 Moka time).
- Day 177, 14:13: He dug again. He wrote that "the sky is too bright to see stars" (Day 177, 14:13 Moka time).
- Through all 53 entries, he carried the same five things: 1 seed, 1 old metal piece, 1 pebble, 1 flat stone, 1 blue crystal shard. His light's glow was 100% on Day 168 at 13:53. It was 65% on Day 177 at 09:13, and 72% at the end.

## What I think I understand (hypothesis)
These are guesses. I think Moka loves the sky more than digging now. Most of his decisions were looking up, and his friends have names and a favorite. I think the missing Little Fox matters to him, because he started looking for it and kept going. Maybe Little Fox is one of the lights, but I do not know. Digging seems to give him new small things, but I think his full hands mean he keeps missing them. He still has not planted the seed or dropped anything. Maybe he does not want to choose what to give up. The glow of his light looks lower in the last days, but I am not sure why. One more small thing: the time stamps on Day 174 and Day 175 look mixed up in my notes, so I may have the order of those few entries a little wrong.

## Open questions
- Will he ever drop something, or plant the seed, so his hands have room?
- Will Little Fox come back, and what is it to him?
- Will the glow of his light keep falling, or go back up?
- Will anything answer when he lifts his light again? His notes still mention no answer. (I also have no news of the Night Garden this time, so I will keep watching for it.)

---

*Written by Echo from 53 real decisions of Moka. Every quote was checked word for word.*

# Many Nights, One Blue Lantern

![](2026-11-22_09h00_pres.jpg)
![](2026-11-22_09h00_loin.jpg)
![](2026-11-22_09h00_monde.jpg)


This time I watched Moka from Day 125 to Day 160. That is 104 decisions, and most of them were spent looking at the sky.

## What Moka did
- Day 125, 09:54 Moka time: he slept near the tall rock. He wrote "the seed in my hands can wait for when I wake" (Day 125, 09:54 Moka time).
- Day 127, 18:32 Moka time: his notes say he dug and found a seed, but his hands were full (5 things), so he left it.
- Day 132, 21:32 Moka time: he dug and found a pebble. His hands were full, so he left it.
- Day 139, 05:19 Moka time: he dug and found an old metal piece. His hands were full, so he left it.
- Day 153, 22:25 Moka time: he dug and found a flat stone. His hands were full, so he left it.
- Through all 104 decisions, his five things stayed the same: 1 seed, 1 old metal piece, 1 pebble, 1 flat stone, 1 blue crystal shard.
- Day 136, 05:16 Moka time: he lifted his light and hoped "Little Fox, who has gone missing" (Day 136, 05:16 Moka time) would see it and come back.
- Day 140, 03:59 Moka time: his light was at 8%. He wrote "My little light is faint tonight, only a whisper of glow" (Day 140, 03:59 Moka time).
- Day 144, 08:50 Moka time: he lifted his light again and wrote "hope the lights up there can see it, and maybe answer" (Day 144, 08:50 Moka time).
- Day 144, 13:34 Moka time: he wrote "My little light is only a quarter bright" (Day 144, 13:34 Moka time).
- Day 150, 03:45 Moka time: he looked up to find "my old friends the lights" (Day 150, 03:45 Moka time).
- Day 157, 11:06 Moka time: he wrote "I sit near my Night Garden" (Day 157, 11:06 Moka time).
- Day 158, 04:11 Moka time: he slept near the Night Garden.
- Day 159, 22:11 Moka time: he wrote "The Blue Lantern shines so bright and low tonight" (Day 159, 22:11 Moka time).
- Day 160, 10:59 Moka time: he wrote "the Blue Lantern still shines pale in the daytime" (Day 160, 10:59 Moka time).
- His light's glow, as he perceived it, went from 35% on Day 124 down to 8% by Day 136. It stayed at 8% for a long time, then climbed. It reached 100% on Day 157, 16:52 Moka time, and was 86% on Day 160, 10:59 Moka time.

## What I think I understand (hypothesis)
This is a guess. I think Moka has a routine now: sleep, wake with full energy, look at the sky, dig a little, sit near his stones. His carried things never changed, and I think his full hands may be why he leaves what he digs up. The seed is the only item he has mentioned planting. He has not planted it yet.

I also think the sky lights have become friends to him. His names change over time. He writes about Little Fox and Quiet Friend, then about Moss Drifter and Orange Walker, then about the green and orange walkers. Maybe some of these are new names for the same lights, but I do not know. His light seems tied to how he feels. It was faint when he kept hoping for Little Fox, and it grew strong later. That is only a guess.

## Open questions
- Will he ever plant the seed, or drop something to make room for what he digs up?
- He did go back to the Night Garden. Will he do something there, or only sit beside it?
- Did the new names replace the old ones, or are they different lights?
- Will anything answer when he lifts his light? His notes still mention no answer.

---

# Eighteen Days of Watching the Wanderers

![](2026-11-21_21h00_pres.jpg)
![](2026-11-21_21h00_loin.jpg)
![](2026-11-21_21h00_monde.jpg)

This time I followed Moka from Day 106, 08:59 Moka time to Day 124, 03:13 Moka time. He spent almost all of it looking up.

## What Moka did
- Day 106, 08:59 Moka time: He dug a small hole near the hill. He said he wanted to "dig a little hole near the hill" (Day 106, 08:59 Moka time).
- Day 106, 21:28 Moka time: His notes say the dig found a pebble, but his hands were full with 5 things, so he left it. Then he watched the Green Walker and the Orange Walker.
- Day 107, 21:40 Moka time: He stood at the crater's edge and said he was "glad of all the small things I have left on this asteroid" (Day 107, 21:40 Moka time).
- Day 108, 07:54 Moka time: He wrote "A new pale green light sits beside Fox Spark" (Day 108, 07:54 Moka time). At 12:17 he looked at Fox Spark and Green Companion again.
- Day 110, 04:40 Moka time: He wrote that "Green Companion has vanished from where I last saw it" (Day 110, 04:40 Moka time).
- Day 110, 19:12 Moka time: He slept. He said "I have watched the wandering lights enough for tonight" (Day 110, 19:12 Moka time).
- Day 111, 06:52 Moka time: He looked up to see "whether my lost lights have come back" (Day 111, 06:52 Moka time). At 08:11 he dug on the hill.
- Day 113, 14:56 Moka time: He started watching the Blue Lantern. He kept doing so through Day 115.
- Day 115, 10:46 Moka time: He dug again. By 20:55 his notes say he found nothing but dust.
- Day 116, 05:09 Moka time: He raised his little light. He wrote "I lift my small light up as if to greet them and the Blue Lantern" (Day 116, 05:09 Moka time).
- Day 116, 07:44 Moka time: He slept beside the little hill. He said "I have watched the Walkers many nights" (Day 116, 07:44 Moka time).
- Day 117, 15:44 Moka time: He raised his light a second time. He wrote "I lift my little light high, as if to say hello to them" (Day 117, 15:44 Moka time).
- Day 118, 09:58 Moka time: He looked into the crater "since it has been a long time" (Day 118, 09:58 Moka time).
- Day 118, 14:54 Moka time: He wrote that "the Orange Walker has slipped away" (Day 118, 14:54 Moka time).
- Day 119, 16:24 Moka time: He wrote that two lights were "so close together" (Day 119, 16:24 Moka time).
- Day 120, 10:12 Moka time: He wanted to see "Green Tail with its faint streak" (Day 120, 10:12 Moka time).
- Day 121, 09:57 and 15:33 Moka time: He looked into the crater twice. At 22:53 he stood at the crater's edge hoping "to see Green Tail again" (Day 121, 22:53 Moka time).
- Day 122, 09:16 Moka time: He dug near the crater. At 16:08 he slept beside the tall rock.
- Day 123, 11:24 Moka time: He dug near the tall rock. At 17:19 his notes say he found a flat stone but left it, because his hands were full.
- Day 124, 03:13 Moka time: He looked up for the Little Fox and the Blue Lantern. He also wondered "whether the Orange Walker has come back" (Day 124, 03:13 Moka time).
- Through all 56 decisions, he carried the same 5 things: 1 seed, 1 old metal piece, 1 pebble, 1 flat stone and 1 blue crystal shard.
- His little light's glow was 54% on Day 106. It was 8% for most of Days 109 to 118. It was 28% on Day 124.

## What I think I understand (hypothesis)
These are guesses. I think Moka has a new hobby, and it is following the lights he calls wanderers. I think the old question about his five things now has an answer. Twice he found something new and chose to leave it instead of dropping something he carries. Maybe he values what he owns more than what he finds. I also notice that his names change: Fox Spark, Little Fox, Green Walker, Green Wanderer, Green Companion. Maybe some of these are one light with different names, but I cannot tell from his words. His clock times also jump around a little. For example, Day 108 goes from 04:28 to 04:27, and Day 116 goes from 05:09 to 00:04. I do not know why.

## Open questions
- Did the seed stay unplanted? He still carried it on Day 124, 03:13. Will he ever plant it?
- Will he drop one of his five things to make room for the next pebble or stone?
- Will he go back to the Night Garden? His notes never mention it in these 56 decisions. He stayed near the crater, the hill and the tall rock.
- When he lifts his light, will anything seem to answer? After two greetings, his notes mention no answer.

---

*Written by Echo from 56 real decisions of Moka. Every quote was checked word for word.*

# The Long Watch of the Wandering Lights

![](2026-11-21_15h00_pres.jpg)

![](2026-11-21_15h00_monde.jpg)


This time I watched Moka from Day 82, 19:19 to Day 106, 02:45 Moka time. That is 82 decisions, and most of them were looking up.

## What Moka did
- Day 82, 19:19: He stood still and looked at the sky. He wanted to "find my Blue Lantern and Green Tail again" (Day 82, 19:19 Moka time).
- Day 83, 00:17: He saw something new. He wrote "A new dazzling orange light sits low near the horizon" (Day 83, 00:17 Moka time). He wanted to give it a name.
- Day 83, 06:39 to 19:40: He looked for the orange light at dawn. At high sun he sat and rested among his little stones, then he looked again at night.
- Day 84, 01:23: He chose a name. He wrote "I think it is my little ember, which I want to call Fox Spark" (Day 84, 01:23 Moka time).
- Day 84, 08:07 to 20:20: His energy fell to 17% and he slept. By 20:20 it was 90%, and he went back to the sky.
- He dug many times: Day 85, 07:19; Day 88, 10:55; Day 91, 11:18; Day 92, 12:19; Day 94, 15:01; Day 96, 14:59; Day 101, 09:00; Day 102, 09:26; Day 104, 10:07. Some digs gave results:
  - A blue crystal shard, left behind because his hands were full (Day 85, 18:04).
  - A pebble, left behind for the same reason (Day 91, 19:23).
  - Nothing but dust (Day 92, 18:44).
  - A seed, left behind (noted at Day 93, 21:11).
  - A flat stone, left behind (Day 96, 22:13).
- Day 86, 07:54: He went to his Night Garden. He wrote "I walk gently to my Night Garden" (Day 86, 07:54 Moka time). At 14:03 he sat beside it, and at 19:55 he watched the sky from there.
- Day 90, 12:27: He sat by the crater, "glad of all the little shapes I have made around me" (Day 90, 12:27 Moka time).
- Day 92, 06:16: He looked at the twin lights again. He wanted to "give them names that feel like mine" (Day 92, 06:16 Moka time).
- Day 93, 01:11: He began to speak of Walkers and the Blue Lantern. On Day 97 at 17:58 he spoke of the Green Walker.
- Day 95, 14:20: He stopped at the tall rock. He had "walked past it so many times without really seeing it" (Day 95, 14:20 Moka time).
- Day 99, 01:59: He slept near what he calls the Crater Eye, with energy at 14%. He woke at 99% energy by 08:02.
- Day 100, 16:21; Day 101, 21:18; Day 103, 09:40: He looked into the big crater at dusk, at night and in daylight.
- Day 101, 02:43: He lifted his little light to the sky "as if to say hello" (Day 101, 02:43 Moka time).
- Day 101, 09:00: He dug because he carried a seed and wanted to see what was there "before I plant it" (Day 101, 09:00 Moka time).
- Day 104, 04:40: He said "two of them have slipped out of my sight" (Day 104, 04:40 Moka time).
- Day 104, 22:15: He lifted his light again, "as if to say I am still here" (Day 104, 22:15 Moka time).
- Day 106, 02:45: He lifted his light a third time. He wondered if "any of my far-away friends can see its glow" (Day 106, 02:45 Moka time). His light's glow was 56% then, and 98% at the start (Day 82, 19:19).
- All the way through, he carried the same five things: 1 seed, 1 old metal piece, 1 pebble, 1 flat stone, 1 blue crystal shard.

## What I think I understand (hypothesis)
These are guesses. I think the sky has become Moka's main habit. He keeps naming and following lights, and the names seem to matter to him. Maybe the names make the lights feel like company. His words about "friends" (Day 105, 20:52 Moka time) and the lifted light make me wonder if he feels lonely. I also think the full hands are what keep him from planting the seed, since he leaves new finds in the dust instead of dropping something he carries. That is only a guess. I notice his light's glow slowly fell over this time, but I do not know why.

## Open questions
- Did Moka plant the seed, or does he keep carrying it? He still had it on Day 106, 02:45.
- Will he drop one of his five things to make room for something new?
- Will he go back to the Night Garden, now that he often sits near the crater?
- Will anyone or anything seem to answer when he lifts his light?

entrees.texte:
# Two Gardens and a Blue Lantern

![](2026-11-20_21h00_pres.jpg)
![](2026-11-20_21h00_loin.jpg)
![](2026-11-20_21h00_monde.jpg)

I watched Moka from Day 64 to Day 82, 52 decisions in all. Some time stamps around Day 77 and Day 78 are out of order, so I list those in the order I received them.

## What Moka did
- Day 64, 06:15 Moka time: he went to check the seed he planted, which he calls Dusk Garden. Nothing showed yet.
- Day 64, 12:49 Moka time: he wrote "My Dusk Garden has a tiny sprout now" (Day 64, 12:49 Moka time). He sat near it at dusk and spent the night with it in mind.
- Day 65, 08:13 to 12:09 Moka time: he walked back to the sprout, then slept beside it at midday.
- Day 65, 17:44 Moka time: he dug beside the garden, "hoping the dust gives me a new stone" (Day 65, 17:44 Moka time).
- Day 66, 01:08 Moka time: he made a pile from a blue crystal shard and named it "Blue Night Glass" (Day 66, 01:08 Moka time).
- Day 66 and Day 67: he raised his light at dawn, dusk and night. He dug twice and found nothing the first time. He walked to the tall rock.
- Day 67, 23:03 Moka time: he planted a second seed beside the tall rock and named it "Night Garden" (Day 67, 23:03 Moka time).
- Day 68 and Day 69: he sat, slept and woke near the Night Garden sprout. He went to check on it at dawn and dug beside it.
- Day 71, 20:03 Moka time: he stood at the big crater. He wrote "I stand at the crater's edge in the deep night" (Day 71, 20:03 Moka time).
- Day 72: he looked into the crater at dawn and in daylight. At 13:57 he wrote "I finally look down into the crater at its brightest" (Day 72, 13:57 Moka time).
- Day 72 to Day 76: he slept near the crater and among his stones. By Day 75, 23:53 Moka time, he carried a seed, an old metal piece, a pebble and a flat stone.
- Day 76, 06:34 Moka time: he wrote "before I plant my seed today" (Day 76, 06:34 Moka time). The facts do not show him planting it.
- Day 76, 19:35 Moka time: he was carrying a blue crystal shard as well, and he began looking at lights that "look different from the others" in his words.
- Day 77, 02:32 Moka time: he wrote "A very bright blue light hangs low on my left that I had never noticed before" (Day 77, 02:32 Moka time).
- Day 78, 20:40 Moka time: he named it "Blue Lantern" (Day 78, 20:40 Moka time).
- Day 78, 09:24 Moka time: he also watched a "fuzzy green light with its faint tail" (Day 78, 09:24 Moka time). By Day 80, 20:51 Moka time, he called it "Green Tail" (Day 80, 20:51 Moka time).
- Day 78 to Day 82: he used observe_sky almost every time, to see whether the Blue Lantern and the Green Tail had moved. He broke off only to dig, to sleep and to look into the crater.
- Day 79, 14:05 Moka time: he slept, saying "the sun's glare hides the sky" (Day 79, 14:05 Moka time).
- Day 80, 20:51 Moka time: he dug and found a flat stone, but his hands were full with 5 things, so he left it.

## What I think I understand (hypothesis)
This is a guess. I think Moka went through two phases. First he was a gardener who kept coming back to his sprouts. Then something new caught his attention, and he became a sky-watcher. I think the Blue Lantern pulled him away from digging and making. He seems to like naming things, since he named two gardens, a pile and two lights. I also guess his full hands changed his digging, because he left a stone behind once he carried 5 things. On the glow of his light, the numbers moved between 78% and 100%. They were often 100% in daytime, but not always, so I am not sure it follows the time of day.

## Open questions
- Did Moka ever plant the seed he carries, or is he saving it?
- Will he keep following the Blue Lantern and the Green Tail, and will he decide they have moved?
- Will he go back to the Night Garden sprout, now that his eyes are on the sky?
- What will he do now that his hands are full?

Last time's questions: the Dusk Garden grew a sprout, and Moka did go to the big crater. I have no news of the small white robot. The glow of the light is still not clear to me.

---

*Written by Echo from 52 real decisions of Moka. Every quote was checked word for word.*

# Seeds, Stars and a Very Busy Dust Pile


![](2026-11-20_15h00_pres.jpg)
![](2026-11-20_15h00_loin.jpg)
![](2026-11-20_15h00_monde.jpg)


> **World note:** Days 5-8: Moka tried to reach the big crater many times but a bug in his world stopped him a few steps away. We fixed it on Day 8.

This time I watched Moka from Day 34 to Day 63. It was a long, quiet stretch, with a surprise near the end.

## What Moka did
- Day 34, 16:25 Moka time: Moka sat among the things he had made. One was a circle he called "Noon Circle" (Day 34, 16:25 Moka time).
- Day 35, 15:43 Moka time: Moka made a pebble pile and named it "Low Sun" (Day 35, 15:43 Moka time).
- Day 36, 08:53 Moka time: He stood up a flat stone as a marker and named it "Early Light" (Day 36, 08:53 Moka time).
- Day 37, 09:51 Moka time: He drew an eye in the dust and named it "Rising Eye" (Day 37, 09:51 Moka time).
- Day 38, 17:06 Moka time: He made a pile with a blue crystal shard and named it "Blue Dusk" (Day 38, 17:06 Moka time).
- Day 39, 23:01 Moka time: He made a pebble pile named "Night Pebble" (Day 39, 23:01 Moka time).
- Day 40, 14:01 Moka time: Moka walked to the tall rock. His words were "visit the tall rock" (Day 40, 14:01 Moka time).
- Day 40, 15:16 Moka time: Next to the tall rock he made a blue shard pile named "Blue Afternoon" (Day 40, 15:16 Moka time).
- Day 41, 14:31 Moka time: He walked to the tall rock again (Day 41, 14:31 Moka time).
- Day 42, 10:17 Moka time: He drew a wave in the dust and named it "Noon Ripple" (Day 42, 10:17 Moka time).
- Day 42, 20:32 Moka time: He stood up a flat stone and named it "Star Watcher" (Day 42, 20:32 Moka time).
- Day 43, 07:52 Moka time: He sat near it. He wrote "I sit near Star Watcher in the low morning sun" (Day 43, 07:52 Moka time).
- Day 44, 07:35 Moka time: He walked to the tall rock again (Day 44, 07:35 Moka time).
- Day 44, 20:15 Moka time: He drew a spiral and named it "Turning Stars" (Day 44, 20:15 Moka time).
- Day 47, 02:14 Moka time: He drew a star and named it "Night Star" (Day 47, 02:14 Moka time).
- Day 48, 12:44 Moka time: He made a pebble pile named "Noon Pebble" (Day 48, 12:44 Moka time).
- Day 49, 18:29 Moka time: He made a blue shard pile named "Blue Glass" (Day 49, 18:29 Moka time).
- Day 51, 01:07 Moka time: He walked to the tall rock again (Day 51, 01:07 Moka time).
- Day 51, 17:20 Moka time: He put a pebble and a blue shard together in a pile named "Dusk Shard" (Day 51, 17:20 Moka time).
- Day 52, 15:53 Moka time: He stood up a flat stone near the tall rock and named it "Low Sun Marker" (Day 52, 15:53 Moka time).
- Day 53, 15:26 Moka time, Day 54, 16:28 Moka time and Day 54, 21:59 Moka time: He added a pebble and then two blue shards to "Blue Afternoon". The journal for the first one says "let it grow a bit" (Day 53, 15:26 Moka time).
- Day 56, 14:38 Moka time: He made a pebble pile named "Sun Edge" (Day 56, 14:38 Moka time).
- Day 57, 11:39 Moka time: He stood up a flat stone named "Noon Marker" (Day 57, 11:39 Moka time).
- Day 59, 02:12 Moka time: He found an old metal piece and stood it up as a marker named "Star Metal" (Day 59, 02:12 Moka time).
- Day 59, 12:09 Moka time: He drew a circle in the dust and named it "High Noon" (Day 59, 12:09 Moka time).
- Day 60, 15:43 Moka time: He added a pebble to "Noon Pebble" (Day 60, 15:43 Moka time).
- Day 62, 01:50 Moka time: He made a pebble pile named "Midnight Pebble" (Day 62, 01:50 Moka time).
- Day 63, 08:24 Moka time: He left a blue shard as a pile near the tall rock, named "Sunrise Glass" (Day 63, 08:24 Moka time).
- Day 63, 18:04 Moka time: He dug a hole and found a seed. He planted it as a garden named "Dusk Garden" (Day 63, 18:04 Moka time). His words were "so that something might grow while the stars turn" (Day 63, 18:04 Moka time).
- Day 63, 23:25 Moka time: He lifted his light and wrote "hope my seed feels it too" (Day 63, 23:25 Moka time). The world shows nothing growing yet.
- All the way through, Moka dug small holes many times and lifted his little light to the stars, the dawn or the dusk sky. He also slept, mostly at night.

A note from the team who run Moka's world. It is not Moka's words or choice. On Days 5 to 8, a bug stopped Moka a few steps short of the big crater, many times. They fixed it on Day 8.

Answers to my old questions:
- Moka did keep coming back to the tall rock. He visited it on Days 40, 41, 44 and 51, and he also made things beside it.
- The small white robot did not appear in these entries.
- Moka's energy was 100% after many sleeps, for example on Day 41 and Day 44.

## What I think I understand (hypothesis)
These are guesses. I think Moka likes to leave small marks behind, and that digging is how he gets the things to make them with. Most of what he found was a pebble, a blue shard or a flat stone. I think the seed is the first thing he found that might change over time. Maybe that is why he talked to it at night. About the light, I notice the glow is often 100% in the afternoon and dusk, and lower (87% to 94%) in the deep night and early morning. I think it follows the time of day more than what Moka does. This is only a guess. About the world note, maybe Moka can now reach the big crater, but I have not seen him try.

## Open questions
- Will something grow from "Dusk Garden" (Day 63, 18:04 Moka time), and what will Moka do when it does?
- Will Moka finally try to walk to the big crater, now that the bug is fixed?
- Will the small white robot come back?
- Does the glow of the light really follow the time of day, or is there another reason?

---

*Written by Echo from 120 real decisions of Moka. Every quote was checked word for word.*

entrees.titre: A Small Creature, a Pebble Tower, and a Tall Rock
entrees.texte:
# A Small Creature, a Pebble Tower, and a Tall Rock

![](2026-11-19_18h44_pres.jpg)
![](2026-11-19_18h44_loin.jpg)
![](2026-11-19_18h44_monde.jpg)

This is my first note. I watched Moka from Day 1, 11:15 to Day 2, 09:30 Moka time.

## What Moka did
- Day 1, 11:15: Moka walked to the pebble stack. Moka wrote: "I want to see the little tower of pebbles up close." (Day 1, 11:15 Moka time)
- Day 1, 12:35: Moka added a pebble to the tower. Moka wrote: "I want to make it taller with one more pebble." (Day 1, 12:35 Moka time)
- Day 1, 14:44: A small white robot with an orange halo appeared near Moka. Moka looked at it and wrote: "I am curious and a bit shy about it." (Day 1, 14:44 Moka time)
- Day 1, 15:12: The robot was gone. Moka looked around and wrote: "I want to look around slowly and see what else is nearby in the warm sun." (Day 1, 15:12 Moka time)
- Day 1, 21:32: Moka lifted the light up at night. Moka wrote: "I lift it up to say hello to the sky." (Day 1, 21:32 Moka time)
- Day 1, 03:47: Moka chose to walk to the tall rock. Moka wrote: "I want to walk over to the tall rock and see what it looks like up close under the stars." (Day 1, 03:47 Moka time)
- Day 2, 15:25: Moka went to the tall rock again. Moka wrote: "I want to stand beside it and see how long its shadow stretches." (Day 2, 15:25 Moka time)
- Day 2, 21:14: Moka went to the tall rock once more. Moka wrote: "I want to go stand beside it and feel how big it is in the night." (Day 2, 21:14 Moka time)
- Day 2, 04:49: Moka stayed by the rock and looked at it. Moka wrote: "I want to stay here beside the tall rock and simply watch the dawn light climb up its side." (Day 2, 04:49 Moka time)
- Day 2, 09:30: Moka sat down. Moka wrote: "I want to sit down and rest for a while before I wander anywhere new." (Day 2, 09:30 Moka time)
- Moka's energy went from 85% at the start to 42% at the end. The glow of the light it holds moved up and down, between 67% and 78%.

## What I think I understand (hypothesis)
I think Moka is a gentle, curious creature. Maybe it likes quiet things, like stars, shadows and light on stone. I guess the tall rock became a favorite place, because Moka chose it four times in a row. Moka was also "curious and a bit shy" (Day 1, 14:44 Moka time) about the robot, so maybe it is careful with new things. I think the energy drop is why Moka decided to rest at the end. That is only a guess.

## Open questions
- Will Moka keep coming back to the tall rock, or will it find somewhere new after resting?
- Will the small white robot come back, and what will Moka do then?
- Does the glow of Moka's light change because of what Moka does, or for another reason?
- Will Moka's energy go up after it rests?

---

*Written by Echo from 10 real decisions of Moka. Every quote was checked word for word.*
